anilao-mabini-batangas.why: Bus and jeep from Manila; dive resorts arrange transfers
anilao-mabini-batangas.caveat: Dive only with accredited shops and certified guides.

baguio-night-market.why: A walk from Session Road; easy to graze alone
baguio-night-market.caveat: Pickpockets work the crowd; keep your phone in front.

baguio-public-market.why: A walk from Session Road; browse at your own pace
baguio-public-market.caveat: Very crowded; keep your bag in front.

basco-lighthouse-naidi-hills-basco.why: Tricycle or a 1.2 km hike from Basco Port
basco-lighthouse-naidi-hills-basco.caveat: The top deck is windy; hold on to your phone.

basilica-del-santo-nino-cebu.why: Downtown Cebu, with jeepneys passing nearby
basilica-del-santo-nino-cebu.caveat: Strict dress code; heavy crowds on Fridays and Sundays.

bencab-museum-tuba.why: Asin-bound jeep from Baguio; a quiet museum to take slowly
bencab-museum-tuba.caveat: Closed Mondays; the garden trail slopes, so wear grippy shoes.

bulabog-beach-boracay.why: A short walk from Station 2; learn at a certified kite school
bulabog-beach-boracay.caveat: Don't swim in the kite zone; White Beach is for swimming.

camsur-watersports-complex-pili.why: A jeep or tricycle from Naga; instructors brief you on site
camsur-watersports-complex-pili.caveat: Wear the helmet and vest; start on the beginner cable.

cebu-taoist-temple.why: 15 to 20 minutes by taxi or Grab from IT Park or Ayala
cebu-taoist-temple.caveat: Hot, steep steps; dress modestly in the prayer areas.

diniwid-beach-boracay.why: A walk on the rock path from Station 1
diniwid-beach-boracay.caveat: No lifeguards and a narrow path; go in daylight.

donsol-whale-shark-interaction.why: Van from Legazpi; a BIO guides you in the water
donsol-whale-shark-interaction.caveat: Boats skip rough days, so keep an extra day.

garin-farm-san-joaquin.why: Bus or jeepney south from Iloilo City
garin-farm-san-joaquin.caveat: The white area is bright and hot; bring an umbrella and water.

iloilo-river-esplanade.why: In the city, with several access points
iloilo-river-esplanade.caveat: Stay on the path, away from the river edge.

malapascua-thresher-shark-dive.why: Bus and boat from Cebu; dive with an accredited shop
malapascua-thresher-shark-dive.caveat: Don't fly within 24 hours of your last dive.

miagao-church.why: About an hour by jeep or bus from Iloilo City
miagao-church.caveat: An active church: dress modestly and mind the highway traffic.

mirador-heritage-park-baguio.why: 10 to 15 minutes by taxi from downtown Baguio
mirador-heritage-park-baguio.caveat: Steep stairs in parts; it's a retreat area, so keep it quiet.

mt-tapyas-coron.why: A walk or short tricycle ride from Coron town
mt-tapyas-coron.caveat: Bring a light for the walk down after sunset.

peoples-park-davao.why: Downtown Davao, a short taxi or Grab ride
peoples-park-davao.caveat: Davao strictly enforces its no-smoking and no-littering rules.

plaza-burgos-empanada-vigan.why: A walk from Calle Crisologo to the stalls
plaza-burgos-empanada-vigan.caveat: Bring small bills for the stalls.

rizal-boulevard-dumaguete.caveat: Keep bags close in the evening crowd.

sabang-beach-baler.why: Bus to Baler, then a tricycle; surf schools on the beach
sabang-beach-baler.caveat: Learn with an instructor and stay out on red-flag days.

tam-awan-village-baguio.why: Jeepney from Kayang Street; easy to wander alone
tam-awan-village-baguio.caveat: Trails are steep and slippery after rain.

urbiztondo-beach-san-juan-la-union.why: Buses from Manila stop at Urbiztondo
urbiztondo-beach-san-juan-la-union.caveat: New to surfing? Book an instructor.

valugan-boulder-beach-basco.caveat: Not for swimming: strong waves and slippery boulders.
